title: Extrapolative machine learning identifies a multielement RWGS catalyst
summary: In a closed loop combining machine-learning prediction with experiments, researchers tested 300 reverse water-gas shift catalyst formulations over 44 cycles, starting from 45 data points. They report Pt(3)/Rb(1)-Ba(1)-Mo(0.6)-Nb(0.2)/TiO₂ as the optimal tested composition; Nb was absent from the initial dataset. The result is specific to the study’s catalyst tests and conditions, not commercial CO₂ conversion. The earlier ChemRxiv version is not used to claim priority here.
ai_technology: Extrapolative machine learning; closed-loop prediction and experiment
organization: Hokkaido University; Kogakuin University; RIKEN; ENEOS Corporation

evidence.tested: The source reports 300 experimentally tested catalysts over 44 ML-plus-experiment cycles and identifies the best tested formulation.
evidence.unknown: Commercial operation, independent replication and performance beyond reported experimental conditions are not established.
evidence.ai_role: Machine-learning predictions guide sequential catalyst selection; experimental results update the closed-loop search.
